description: Forward Claude Code hook events to the local coflux daemon via the cofluxd messenger (silent no-op when cofluxd is not installed), and inside a coflux project session steer `git worktree add|remove|move` to the coflux MCP workspace tools.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v cofluxd >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec cofluxd hook claude || :'
